result.summary: Found 1 issue: a restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' section failed to load and shows a broken-image placeholder.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the large image card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar is missing its photo and instead shows a broken-image icon centered on a plain gray background, while the rest of the card (delivery badge, favorite icon, and restaurant details) renders normally.
issues.suggestion: Verify the image URL/asset path loads correctly and supply a proper fallback image plus descriptive alt text so the card does not appear broken when the photo fails to load.
